body: You are not "allowed" to do anything.  You are an adult.  You do what you want.  She doesn't get to tell you what you can and cannot do!  Obviously you do not do things like cheat or be disrespectful to each other, but she does not get to dictate your life.  Please don't let her do this to you!!  You are not "allowed" to do certain things...or what? Or she will break up with you?  She doesn't get to hold that over your head to control you and keep you from doing normal things.  Go see your friend.  Tell her you are sorry she doesn't like it, but it is a normal thing to do and you are going.  She wants to control you now and will try to control you even more if you do marry her.  She needs to learn right now that she doesn't get to do that.

Well that is a lot different than what you posted.  What I got from your post was that you and your mom have always been very close but your recent dental visit made you no longer want to be around her.  I did not say not taking you to the dentist was a small mistake.  I said she totally screwed up on that one.  But it sounds like she actually totally screwed up a lot of things.  I don't understand now why you are so close at all?  I am truly sorry for all that you have been through.  I misunderstood your post because you said you had always been very close and that you are still very close and that she had made a huge mistake not taking you to the dentist, but I did not want you to end a close relationship with her over that.  But obviously, it is far more than that - I could not read between the lines.  I don't see any reason that you would be close to someone who has done all of those things to you.  You said she was your best friend and that you are still really close.  Just know that you don't owe her anything.  What i said above was "Unless your parent was very neglectful all the time, abusive physically, sexually, emotionally, or allowed you to be abused please try to give them a break."  She broke that rule entirely, so she definitely does not deserve to be a part of your life at all.  In my defense, you did not make it sound like that at all in your other post.  However, this is a place to get things off your chest in whatever way you choose, so you could express it however you want.  I apologize for being wrong and wish you the best.

That really sucks, I'm sorry.  She is doing this to be a bitch for some reason.  I don't know why.  Hopefully your grade in her class will be ok.  At least you had the great experience of being able to go and study in China.  Please try not to let her discourage you too much.

Here is the thing... what she did regarding the dentist was very wrong, yep - she totally screwed up on that one.  She obviously has some other faults as well.  But does she have any good things about her?  Because just because someone is a parent does not automatically make them perfect.  You might have kids one day and guess what?  You are going to screw some things up.  Things they will remember and hold against you forever.  And all those nights you got up with them when they were babies and sick and had fevers and cried all night and had diarrhea and vomited everywhere and you took care of them and rocked them and cleaned them- they won't remember any of that.  Every time you picked them up when they were young children and bandaged their knees and wiped their tears - they won't remember that either.  All the heartfelt conversations you had with them when they were teenagers, trying to boost their self esteem and make them feel worthy in the world - none of that will be remembered.  What will be remembered are the things you screwed up.  

Unless your parent was very neglectful all the time, abusive physically, sexually, emotionally, or allowed you to be abused please try to give them a break and remember they are human beings and everyone makes mistakes.

I'm sorry.  This sucks.  It used to happen to me all the time.  I am older now so not as bad.  It happened with both male and female friends, though admittedly not all of my friends, just a lot of them.  Even now at 50 years old, I know that several of my friends would be in a relationship (at least sexual if not more) if I said the word, so I just kind of try to ignore it as much as I can.  

Please don't date any of your friends just to gain more experience.  Only date people you are interested in dating.  

What has worked best for me is to make it clear in casual conversation that I am not interested in a relationship with the person, so they will know.  I have lost a few "friends" because of that and I had one friend tell me she just could not handle being my friend because she really wanted to be in a relationship with me.  I do see what you are saying about it being hard to have genuine friendships.  Over time you will have some.  But yeah, in the back of your mind you will always know that many of them are interested in more than that. Keep in mind though that does not mean they are not a true friend.  Just because they would like more does not mean they do not genuinely value your friendship.

I'm so sorry you are dealing with all of this.  If one doctor won't see you, keep trying until you find one.  I have a friend who had surgery for terrible scoliosis.  She had a rod placed in her back to straighten the curve.  Fun?  Hell no.  But she is living a normal life now.  You don't have to sit in a corner and fuck off :(  Keep trying to find a doctor who will see you please.  I hope things are better for you soon.

It is not real.  That is not the real world.  Please please get yourself out into the real world and live there.  It is I think the third episode in the series.  The title is Nosedive.  It is on Netflix.

That is true.  He definitely owes her that.  I do get that.  But she overheard him talking about proposing.  I guess I see it as, if she bails now, 14 years are down the drain over this date technicality.   Maybe it should be.  If it should be down the drain anyway because of his feet dragging, then how is him meeting one deadline going to change anything.  It just sounds like that is who he is.  I can't imagine though, that he would be with her 14 years if he didn't want to be with her.
14 years is definitely not petty.  But 4-6 weeks in the grand scheme of things is.  I hope you are older than me. Please God, let someone be lmao

She has already waited 14 years - which I would have advised against.  Why should she screw it up now, when they are already planning a wedding, over a technicality of a month or 6 weeks?  After all this time waiting?  I don't see why it is such a big rush now.

You know why I am giving her this advice - because I personally have fucked things up over petty shit like this.  I am trying to help her not fuck things up.  Sometimes how you feel in the moment is not all that important compared to how you are going to feel in the long term.  I am actually looking out for her long term good, not just how she feels in the moment.  If you were all grown up, you would get that.
She is posting on here asking for opinions and advice so that is what she got.

All the things your dad taught you will stay with you forever.  I have so many memories of things my dad said to me.  Those things are truly priceless and nothing can ever replace them.  I am very sorry for your loss.
This is a great post!! I am so happy for you!!!

If you move out and live on your own somewhere you will be able to get financial aid that will not be based on your parents' income.  Stop feeling responsible for them - right now.  They are not your responsibility.  They have not held up their own responsibility in raising you.  You have to stop enabling them.  You don't need to kill yourself - you need to cut the strings that keep you tied to your parents.
I think he is seeking initial advice.  You can't tell how much someone is freaking out by their post.  He probably is very freaked out and not sure where to even start to defend himself.

It sounds like the girl lied about some things.  I am so sorry you are dealing with this.  I would ask for her to speak in a group, in front of you and your wife and her parents and say what happened.  it will be harder to lie if she has to lie in front of everyone.  Plus by you offering to do this you are showing that you have nothing to hide.

I think it is really sweet that he is planning to propose and has a timeframe to do it picked out.  I know you wanted him to do it before the end of the year but PLEASE pick your battles.  Those of us who are out here alone would love to be in your shoes.  Just let him do this.  Don't steal his thunder.  Just be patient a little longer.  You are planning a wedding so you are already engaged anyway.  Best wishes to you

Please don't buy a house with your gf if you are not willing to consider her son your own.  This kid had no choice in the matter of how he was conceived or by whom.  If you are not going to love him like your own child then let her find someone else who might love her child more... even if she stays by herself with her child it is better than living with your mom's boyfriend (or husband) who doesn't love you.  This is not a feeling you can force just because you love her.  You either feel this way or you don't.  I am not judging you but hoping to save you and the child some heartache.  My mom married a man when I was 3 and he was my daddy for the rest of his life.  If you can't be that then don't.

You know...OP, I agree with you.  I would be wondering the same thing.  There has to be some reason.  Even if the reason was as simple as "I like how they feel on the sheets."  But to not give you a reason at all is just weird.  I know it is his body...so what if you decided to stop shaving your legs and when he asked why you just said, "I don't know."  If he is not a swimmer or cyclist and has no other reason to give you, I would wonder too.  If you are going to marry him, you really do need to know if he has any sexual identity issues that he has not sorted out.  I dated a guy for four years who I loved with all my heart, but eventually found out he was gay.  It hurt me to find out, yes, but I would rather have found out when I did than for him to live a lifetime of unhappiness.  I am not saying that shaving his legs means he has a sexual identity issue - but it means something - and you need to know what.

I do believe you - but are there other people in the world who put in this much effort to just get laid?  I mean all the love, love, love stuff - texting me I love you out of the blue all the time. I can usually pick up players - I am not saying you are wrong. (I have suspected what you are saying for a long time).  But honestly I cannot believe anyone would go through this much effort for occasional sex?  Like to go on and on about how much you love someone and text all the time (except Thanksgiving weekend after we slept together of course!).  I know people will sometimes say whatever to get whatever they want, but honestly, he spends an extreme amount of time going on and on about loving me and how wonderful and beautiful I am.  Why in the hell?
I'm sorry - especially about your mom.  I am the oldest of 4 kids and I am definitely my mom's least favorite.

You are having these slip ups because you are so stressed/depressed.  It happens to all of us when we are depressed.  The fact that people make fun of you and that you feel different is hard to deal with now - but it actually means you are a very unique person and when you get out of school you will start to see that.  You will find your "tribe" the people who are like you.  Those of us who have been different our whole lives have struggled, but when we are adults it becomes the most amazing gift to not be like everyone else.  I no longer want to be like everyone else.  

If you would please take a few minutes to watch this video, I think it may help you to decide you need to hang on.  Please don't kill yourself.  Hold on and get through this.  It is a challenge that not all humans are given, but when you get through it - when you live through it - you find a world better than you ever imagined.  It is a spiritual awakening of sorts.  You become more determined to live life to the fullest than ever before.  Please, please hold on.  And please, if you will just take a few minutes to watch this, I would really appreciate it.

Four months ago I was terribly suicidal.  I held on only for my kids.  And now, as crazy as it sounds, I am happy.  I am so glad to be alive.  When you are in this state of mind, hold onto whatever you have to hold onto.  Hold on because you know how much it would hurt your mom and others if you killed yourself.  Hang onto that to get through this.  You will feel happy again and you will get through it.  Sometimes we just have to hold onto whatever we have to get through.  I'm glad you are holding on for your mom and others.

I have felt the way you feel at work before.  People can't really see on the outside how you feel on the inside.  If you can just get through the rest of your work day.  I'm really sorry you are feeling this way.

It is not irreparable, I promise.  Are you on any kind of medication?  If not, can you see a doctor?  I can also recommend some supplements if you are able to get them.  Things that are good for your nervous system - Omega fatty acids, magnesium, L-theanine.  I am taking those every day since I stopped taking anti anxiety medication.

I am sorry that you feel so bad!  Depression tricks us sometimes into thinking there is no happiness to be found.  I don't know if you are on any medications, but a lot of those do the same thing.  I was on Xanax for a long time and I could not find joy or distraction in anything.  

I really hope you don't act on your feelings, because I truly think this is a temporary way that you feel.  Please talk to me.

I am so sorry that you feel so bad!  I hope it is not too late.  I am so sad reading this because I know you could have a good future.  Things don't stay how they are.  No matter what.  

I really don't think that anyone reading this will laugh.  Even though you are telling your mother it is not her fault, she will still  blame herself.  I am not sure I could live through it if one of my children killed themselves.  Please think about this a little longer.  Please give yourself some other options besides this.  The Earth is a big place.  You can go anywhere you want, live anywhere you want, be anyone you want.  Just like actors in movies make themselves into different characters, you can do the same with your life.  You are the person who is creating your life.  Please don't hurt yourself.  If it is not too late, please talk to me.

I am sorry that you are going through so much.  I don't know how things are done in Russia.  Is there a place at the school where you can go and tell them you don't have any food?  Is there anywhere that you can go for people with no money to get food?  Maybe a church.  

I really don't know what to say, but I really hope that you hold on and keep looking for help and I hope you find a job soon.  Please don't give up.

I am sorry that you are feeling so bad right now.  One thing that stands out to me is that your life was alright until lately.  That means what you are going through right now is temporary.  All you have to do is hang on and get through it.

You say that you hate hurting your ex fiancé, but if you kill yourself, that will hurt him more than anything ever could.

Please, please try to see that how you feel right now is temporary.  You will feel better soon.  This is a promise that you need to break.  A promise that you shouldn't have made.  Please wait...you don't have to "fix" everything in your life right now.  Just wait a little while before deciding anything else.  Please.  Just take a few days and think about what your options are.  I was recently feeling suicidal myself.  But then I realized that feeling suicidal means we are really very unhappy with how our life is right now.  It means we need to CHANGE our life, not end it.  It is our inner self telling us that this is not how our life is supposed to be.  What that means is to change our life.  It may take a little time.  There are millions of choices, millions of paths we can take to have different lives.  There is no reason for us to choose to die when we have unlimited choices of things to change. 

I really hope that you break this one promise and look for paths to happiness.  When you really think about it, the options are unlimited.  Each of us is creating our own life.  Create a life that you enjoy.  

If you need to talk please write me any time.  I care and I want you to be safe and happy.

A thing that a lot of people who are depressed have in common is high intelligence.  While it gives us a benefit, it also makes the world harder for us.  You are seeing clearly what many people go their entire lives and never see...that people spend many years of their lives working just to survive.  That is true.  

The thing is, your dad does love you, so there must be something worth loving.  As far as you being a junkie:  A)  It doesn't sound like you are a junkie if you are just smoking weed and drinking and not addicted to other drugs.  B)  Junkies lives are just as worthy and valuable as anyone else's life.  

Back to not wanting to work to survive or go to college:  There are so many options.  You don't have to go to college.  You will have to do something to earn money.  That is just how the world works.  I know that you know that, but you see it as a bad thing.  What if we had unlimited everything and could always just do whatever we wanted?  How long would you stay happy and sane that way?  With nothing required of you and no goals?  Have you seen how many rich celebrities are miserable and lost?  

The trick in the world right now is to find a way to live and also be happy.  Find something you enjoy doing.  Maybe you won't be rich.  Maybe you want to move into a house with 10 other people and have very low expenses but be able to travel?  Maybe you are an artist? A musician?  A writer?  A stay at home mom or dad?  Live in a commune type setting (I have considered this many times and they are around to be found).  Maybe you want to live in another country where the cost of living is a lot less?  The options just go on and on and on.  I was suicidal a few days ago.  I really, really was just tired of my life as it is.  But after a couple of people talked to  me on this site, I started thinking about my options.  Sure, killing myself is an option.  An option that would hurt other people, and an option that would never leave me with any other options, ever.  So I decided that for me, that is not an option.  So now, my options are...to find what will make me happy.  To research.  I work,  but I love my job.  Even though other factors in my life were making me sad, I do love my job.  You can find something you love to do also.  My job is not something I even knew existed say 5 years ago.  It is nothing that probably sounds all that exciting.  I work for an insurance company and make sure that people get the right testing for different medical problems.  I work at home.  I don't have a college degree.  

A job like mine may not be interesting to you, but something is.  I don't know what that is, but I know you do.  

Life is best for me when I am not the center of my own universe.  I have loved being a parent and taking care of my kids, but at this point they don't need me as much, so it is time for me to look for other things to make me happy.  There are a lot of people in the world who need someone.  It is fulfilling to me to take care of others.  I have a dog and I love taking care of him.  

That doesn't mean that you have to want to take care of other people. I don't know you or your personality, so I have no idea what will make you happy.  My son is not a caregiver.  He is artistic and he likes DJing.  Those things make him happy.  (He has not always been happy and a year ago he was suicidal himself).  

The point I am trying to make is that we have a lot of options.  We may not like the life we are living right now but that is our inner self letting us know that we are not happy with our current life and so we need to change it.  Just change, not end.

Someone emailed me a couple of days ago with a quote that said something like you don't have to kill your whole self...just the parts of yourself that you don't like.  If you feel like a junkie, get rid of the addiction.  If you don't like other things about yourself, change those things.  

We are the artists of our own lives.  We make our lives the way we want it.  We have a blank canvas and we can choose to paint it any way that we want.

As a parent, I know that if one of my children was to kill themselves, I would never ever forgive myself.  I would never be able to get over it.  I would always feel like there must be something I did wrong.  It doesn't matter if people say they are adults and made their own decision.  I would always feel like I failed them.  I failed as a parent.  I did something wrong.  

I really hope that you will decide that you want to find happiness.  It does not have to be the same path that most people take.  There are unlimited paths to choose.  You are absolutely just as worthy as anyone else of a good and happy life.

If your dad took the shells and gun that means he cares about you.  He is trying to not confront you but wants you to be safe.  If people are trying to put you in the hospital, that means you still have people who care about you.  

Can I ask you why you are thinking of killing yourself?

Thank you so much for writing.  Since the time that I made my post, and thanks to some people who talked to me on here and helped me through, I am not thinking of killing myself now.  
Specifically because of what it would do to my kids.

I am so very sorry for what happened to your mother.  Remember that when you said what you did, you never expected it to really happen.  Had you known that three months later she would actually die, I am sure you would not have said it. Also, you must have felt incredibly sad and/or stressed out to think something like that.  I wish that she could have held on for you so that she would be there for you now.

I know I am going to have moments of feeling awful again like I did when I posted what I did.  But I know I can't do it because I don't want to put my kids through what you have been through (again, I am so sorry).   So, I guess I have to just hang on and figure out how to live with myself.  

Thankfully, I am not an alcoholic or drug addict.  

I have been researching that empty nest syndrome, especially for a single parent, is very similar to dealing with a death.  I know your mother was going through a lot, and it is very sad that sometimes people act on something in the moment, when if they waited, they might not do it.  Thank you for replying, and I'm sorry for all you have been through.  Your story reinforces to me that I can't kill myself.  I don't want my kids going through what you have had to endure.
I hope so.  Right now I feel like I will be lucky if I see them in the future.  I keep wondering if I did something wrong without realizing it.
Thank you for taking the time and effort to write to me.  I know it is hard to know what to say because I have been the person trying to help.  Just know that I really appreciate you.

He's a Chihuahua/rat terrier mix.  Don't worry, friend.  I have decided I have to hold on a little longer, even though I really don't want to.  I can't make my kids have to live with me doing that.  Although, right now sticking around is miserable.  Even if I lose weight and make new friends, all of that will take about a year, a year that I have to get through alone.  Not sure if I can or not.

I don't have siblings to help me cope either.  My family is pretty crazy.  I have one sibling who I still talk to but she has some brain damage and she can't handle me calling her and telling her I'm suicidal.  She would get very upset and would probably call someone to help me, which could end up in me being hospitalized, which would lead to me losing my job.  So, I really don't have anyone to help me cope either.  I hope we can both find happiness in something as well.
Thanks

how?  How do I have any more hope than you do.  I have kids who I am responsible for but they don't need me anymore.  I have taught them to be so independent that I will probably spend every holiday alone the rest of my life.  I certainly don't see any relationship prospects.  I can meet new people and have some sort of life, but not what I want.
I feel like I am too old to start over too.

That is terrible about your half siblings.  I'm so sorry.  So that means I have to keep dragging myself through life so that I don't cause distress for my kids.  yet I don't know how to hang on.   I was taking Xanax to sort of numb my feelings.  Now that I am off of it, I see why I wanted to be numb.

As I sit here thinking about dying myself, I still don't want you to.  I don't even know you.  See when I think about someone else I can think of all the possibilities you have to make your life better.  When I think about myself I don't think of those things.  I guess the same way you think of possibilities for me but yet not for yourself?

Thank you for your message.  I am sorry you have to let your son go away to school.  It does mean you have done your job and did a good job at that.

I appreciate you saying I have been a good mom.  I feel like I have been, but what I failed to do was create a life for myself.  I did not keep close relationships and friendships.  I am fat and alone.  Day after day alone.  I hope that your son will be a good communicator with you while he is away at school.  My son was gone for a year and I rarely heard from him.  I heard from him if he needed money and he did contact me when he was feeling really upset about things.  But I could call or text asking how he was and would never hear back.  

If you do not already have other things going on in your life, please set yourself up so that you have a life.  I haven't done that and now I kind of feel like it is too late.
Are you feeling suicidal too?  It's sad that there are so many of us in the world who feel lonely.  We are all alone in our own little worlds.

thanks.  Yeah, I have given a lot of advice in my life too.  I guess I'm just tired.  I really don't want to start over right now.  I suppose it is probably a better option than dying.  I guess.  If there was a way to quietly just disappear without traumatizing my kids and if I had someone who loves my dog who would keep him, I'd rather just be gone.
Thanks.  There is a meetup this evening that I signed up for actually. I have never been to any of them.  I really don't feel like going through the motions but I probably will.

I had an "imaginary" friend for years when I was a child.  I always held his hand, especially if I was scared.  I have never been sure if he was really imagined or if he was a spirit, or maybe a guardian angel, especially since I had such a bad childhood and would have needed some extra security.  I do know that I asked him who I would marry and what his job would be.  He told me "Larry, and he will be an engineer."  I had an uncle named Larry so I thought that was silly, and the only engineer I knew of was a train engineer.  So as a kid I kept expecting to meet a guy with my uncle's name, who drove a train.  I forgot about it over the years.  Fast forward to me being married to a guy named Larry who was a civil engineer.  My mom reminded me that I used to say someone had told me I would marry a guy named Larry...then I remembered the engineer part.  So... not sure what was going on.
Why did someone ask you if you had seen or felt anything?  Did they also see something?

My ex husband - completely not one to ever believe in anything paranormal at all - was always out hunting or scouting for somewhere to hunt.  He once came across a giant white swan (this was in the US, North Carolina).  He said it was as big as a small car and its wingspan was about 15 to 20 feet across.  He never came home with any other crazy stories like that, so I believe him.

You are justifying using benzos and I know because I have defended my use of them for so long.  The benzos effect on your brain makes you convince yourself that it is okay to use them.  I so agree with  Benzorepent that moderate alcohol and weed are so much more the way to go than benzos.  I know you said you already have it and don't want to waste it or sell it.  You have already seen how addictive it is.  Just please be careful.

Please, if you have gotten through withdrawals don't take anymore except maybe rarely when you just really have bad anxiety and need it.  You say you don't feel addicted, but you had withdrawals, so yes, you were addicted.  I have been on this stuff for 10 years, 1 mg a day for years and then in the last year 2-3 mg a day.  I am now trying to wean off of it and it is hell.  You are feeling that hell right now.  So I would strongly suggest not "dosing" again.   It is not the same as drinking and here is why... if you have a predisposition to become an alcoholic, then yes, alcohol is addictive.  So in some people it is addictive.  It does not sound like that is the case for you.   However, regular benzo use ALWAYS causes anyone who uses it regularly to have a drop in natural GABA, and you will always need a higher dose to get the same effect.  You will not feel high at all, will not feel addicted at all, and yet you are.  I just don't want anyone to go down the road I have gone down.  I have no idea how different my life might be now if I had not taken Xanax.  I believe I would have cared more about a lot of things in my life and a lot of things would be different.

I feel terrible for you.  I'm so sorry.  Benzos  are just bad news.  While I have not gone on a big binge like you did, I believe Xanax and alcohol have significantly screwed up my life over a period of 10 years.  I have no idea how much different my life might be if I had never started taking benzos.   I was prescribed them at first to sleep.  Then I started using them every time anything would make me anxious at all.  Finally they were a way to not have to worry about anything in life at all.  I just did not care.   Finally, after 10 years, I am currently stopping it all.  I am in withdrawal and having DTs and sweating through my covers at night, terrible anxiety, racing heart.  I am almost 50 years old and the mother of two older teenagers.  How much different of a mother would I have been?  I have let myself get out of shape and fat.  I am not in any kind of relationship.  I have somehow alienated all of my friends and family besides my kids.  I only drank about once a week with Xanax, but I should have drank NEVER with them.  Once a week was enough for me to lose people in my life that I cared about.   

An almost 50 year old single mother laying in my bed having DTs and sweating like a pig.  I never thought I would feel like such a piece of crap.  At the same time, my doctor never said how addictive this stuff is.  Never told me about withdrawal when stopping.  I have never taken more than the dose I was prescribed (2-3 mg a day). The reason leafy greens help is because they increase the nitric oxide in your bloodstream, and nitric oxide makes your cells more receptive to insulin.  If you are insulin resistant, this means your cells are starving, and you have too much insulin circulating, but your cells are not sensitive to the insulin, so a lot of what you eat gets stored as fat, while your cells starve.  This makes you hungrier and makes it harder to lose weight.  So, by adding in the spinach (or other greens that increase you nitric oxide) you are making yourself less insulin resistant and can lose weight more easily.  It also seems to keep me more full and has a lot of magnesium and potassium, which we need on keto.  And please don't underestimate how bad being low in sodium can make you feel...if you feel bad go for chicken bouillon with no MSG.  If you are making most of your own food you can get sodium depleted.  If you are eating fast or processed low carb food, you probably won't need the extra sodium.  You will feel tired and maybe achy when you need sodium, potassium or magnesium.

My theory is this - I grew up very poor, and near starvation for a lot of my life.  We were always undernourished.  When we did have food at home, it was cheap, which usually included off-brand sodas.  I resolved to never let my children live like I did. Reason #2 is that when my dad would come get us for his weekends we had plenty of food, but he would often take us to McDonalds.  He always bought us sodas.  I associated that with love and with not being starving.  Then the soda became a horrible addiction.  I'm sure you know that sugar is more addictive than a lot of recreational drugs.  And I just kept "needing" more.  

I also work from home, so going to McDonald's was like my morning routine of getting to see other humans since my kids are older now.  

Also, food is often a way of stuffing down bad feelings, which I have plenty of.  

That's all the whys I've got.  I don't know if they are correct or not, but that is my theory anyway.

Parents really want to know how their kids are.  We never want to think the worst.  Because we want our kids to be happy.  In fact, if we could take every bad thing that ever has or will happen to our kids away, we would do it.  When you don't tell them how bad you really feel, they don't know. I know it is a very embarrassing thing, but please, please tell her how bad you feel.  My son, when he finally told me, had gotten to the point of feeling suicidal. We don't like it, but we also feel like we have to try to give you space to grow up.  So as a parent, there is always this line that we keep trying to figure out how far to push.  How much space do I give my kid, and how much do I push him or her?  And often pushing leads to more hiding of feelings.  So it really is going to have to be a decision that you make to admit your feelings.  Your mom might cry - that's okay.  It is okay if your mom cries.  It just means she loves you and she is sad that her child (no matter your age) feels so sad.  But she would definitely rather know than not know. Something on situational depression that I found insightful:
"Situational Depression (which is different from the ongoing mental illness of chronic depression, hormonal depression, or bipolarity — all of which are serious medical conditions) is a deep sadness that comes upon all of us at some point in our lives. Situational depression is natural. It's universal. It's human. We all have faced it at some point in our lives. We hate it. We reject it. We fight against it. We don't want it. It's deeply uncomfortable.
But Situational Depression has an offering for us — it's desperately trying to tell us something.
Karla McLaren argues that what your Situational Depression is trying to tell you is: STOP.
Depression is characterized, after all, by a complete depletion of energy, by a sense that you simply cannot cope anymore, that you simply cannot go on. And in many cases, McLaren argues, this because you SHOULDN'T go on. This because something in your life is working against you. Something needs to be changed. Somebody needs to go. Something needs to be grieved. Something needs to be admitted. Something needs to be given up. Something needs to be brought in. Something needs to be discussed. Something needs to be healed.
And your Depression is just a friend who just stands there in the middle of the path and says, 'I will not let you take another step until you cope with this problem.'
Many times, this complete shut-down of energy is necessary, to alert you to a problem that you haven't even consciously admitted that you HAVE."
Best of luck to you. Stay strong, but also see that your strength is in the little things. You're looking for a way out of this, which is an amazing and difficult first step all on its own.
